## Track C: any SDR clip -> real HDR (In-Context LoRA)

1. **Load Video (C2C)**: the SDR clip at 832 x 480, 73 frames (17n+5). Use the clip's own frame count on the H3 node and on H3 Mask Prep.
2. **Image Stitch** puts it side by side; the mask (left 0 = keep, right 1 = generate) goes through **H3 Mask Prep** into **H3 Masked Replace**, so H3 regenerates only the right half - with the Track C LoRA (trained with docs/research/l9178_h3_hdr_trackc_iclora.yaml, data from `tools/h3_hdr_dataset.py --trackc`).
3. **Image Crop** keeps the right half; **H3 HDR Roundtrip** decodes ACEScct to ACEScg; **Save Video (C2C)** writes LogC3 16-bit DPX.

Core's H3 graph copied from the official blueprint. Experimental: not run on a GPU yet (ledger L9.184).
